headings.rules: H1 must be fluid (text-5xl md:text-7xl). Tracking-tighter is MANDATORY for all headings above text-2xl. Use uppercase with wide tracking for overlines.

body.rules: Text should be muted (#A3A3A3) by default, #EDEDED for emphasis. Leading-relaxed.

visual_enhancers.gradients: NO flat gradients. Use radial gradients for subtle background glows behind charts or heroes. Example: radial-gradient(circle at 50% 50%, rgba(153,27,27,0.1) 0%, transparent 50%).
visual_enhancers.borders: 1px solid borders heavily used to create 'Bento' and architectural strictness. Border collapse strategies for features.
visual_enhancers.shadows: Minimal outer shadows. Use inner glow/shadows on cards to create depth. shadow-[inset_0_1px_0_rgba(255,255,255,0.1)].

custom_components.kinetic_hero: Use framer-motion. Wrapper has overflow-hidden. Text items animate `y` from '100%' to '0%' with a slow ease-out (e.g., [0.22, 1, 0.36, 1]) duration 1.2s. Staggered reveal.
custom_components.floating_nav: Fixed top-0, z-50, framer-motion useScroll to hide at very top and reveal when scrolling down. Glassmorphism: backdrop-blur-xl, bg-[#050505]/80, border-b border-white/10.

custom_svg_charts.donut: SVG <circle> with stroke-dasharray. Use framer-motion to animate stroke-dashoffset from total length to the target percentage. Use crimson, gold, and white/20 for segments.
custom_svg_charts.bar_chart: SVG <rect> animating 'height' and 'y' properties. Muted bars for minority stakes, crimson/gold for controlling stakes.
custom_svg_charts.line_chart: SVG <path>. Set stroke-dasharray and animate stroke-dashoffset from pathLength to 0 for a drawing effect.
custom_svg_charts.control_spectrum: Horizontal stacked bar chart made of simple flex divs with varying width percentages, animating width on load.

custom_components.asset_cards: Dark cards, border-white/5. On hover: border-white/20, subtle translation Y (-2px), and a radial gradient background that follows the mouse (or just a CSS hover glow using box-shadow: 0 0 30px rgba(197, 160, 89, 0.1)).
custom_components.marquee: Use react-fast-marquee. Very slow speed (speed={20}). Content: 'DELAWARE C-CORP • INTERNATIONAL ASSET HOLDINGS • STRATEGIC CONTROL • LONG-TERM OWNERSHIP •'. Font: mono or sans uppercase, muted text.

layouts.hero: 100vh, content bottom-left or center. Massive text. Minimal padding top. High negative space.
layouts.bento_grid: Use grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-12 gap-px bg-white/10 (border collapse hack). Fill cells with bg-[#0A0A0A] to create 1px borders everywhere.
layouts.strategy_timeline: Vertical left border (border-l border-white/10) with nodes (absolute circles). Text content on the right, fading in on scroll.

motion.reveal: Use framer-motion whileInView. y: 20 to y: 0, opacity 0 to 1. Duration 0.8s.
motion.micro_interactions: Buttons: relative, overflow-hidden. Hover creates a sweeping background or scaling text. Use group-hover for arrow translations (translate-x-1).

instructions_to_main_agent: INSTALL DEPENDENCIES: `yarn add framer-motion @studio-freight/react-lenis react-router-dom lucide-react react-fast-marquee clsx tailwind-merge`
NO CHART LIBRARIES: You must build the charts using pure SVG elements within React components, animating them with framer-motion. Do NOT use recharts or chart.js.
STYLING CSS: Add the Google Fonts imports to the main index.css file. Set `.App { background-color: #050505; color: #EDEDED; }`.
APP STRUCTURE: Use react-router-dom to set up the 5 pages. Implement the floating nav to be present across all routes.
KINETIC HERO: Use an array of strings for the headline. Map over them, wrapping each in a `<div className='overflow-hidden'>` and animating the inner `motion.span` from y: '100%' to y: '0%'.

SVG CHARTS: For the Donut chart, calculate the stroke-dasharray (Math.PI * 2 * r), set stroke-dashoffset to the array length, and animate to the correct offset based on percentage. For line charts, animate the path's length.
BORDERS & PADDING: Use generous padding (p-12, p-24). Use 1px borders (border-white/10) to define structural containers.
TESTING: Add data-testid attributes to all navigation links, buttons, and form inputs (e.g., data-testid='nav-holdings-link', data-testid='contact-submit').
ACCESSIBILITY: Ensure text contrast over images using dark gradients or solid black overlays (bg-black/70).
universal_guidelines: Do not center-align the app container. Respect optical alignment.
Do not use generic transitions like 'transition: all'. Use specific transitions (e.g., 'transition-colors duration-300').
Never use pure black without text contrast. Use #050505 for base backgrounds.
Create depth using z-index hierarchy and subtle inner shadows, not massive outer drop shadows.
Forms should not use native HTML styling. Style inputs completely with Tailwind (bg-transparent border-b border-white/20 focus:border-white focus:outline-none).
